title: CPCP Boundary Contract Specification Schema
description: Schema for Contract Protocol for Continuous Pipelines (CPCP) formalizing the boundary between nondeterministic agent/LLM behavior and the deterministic kernel membrane.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for the boundary contract (e.g. CPCP-MEMBRANE-001)

membrane_mode.description: Enforcement mode of the cellular membrane barrier

nondeterministic_layer.description: Scope and protocol of the nondeterministic agent runtime (e.g. MCP / Tool execution)

deterministic_layer.description: Scope of the deterministic knowledge kernel (e.g. CAS storage, WAL, change_journal)

invariants.description: Non-negotiable invariants required for membrane traversal
